Hi Alex — thanks for the details and for joining the demo. I pulled together an initial pricing horizon and a small spreadsheet that shows three starter configurations: Standard (30d traces, 90d metrics), Extended (90d traces, 365d metrics), and Enterprise (365d traces, 2yr metrics + retention archive). Spreadsheet attached (obs-pricing-horizon.xlsx).

A few notes inline:
- Trace sampling: we offer two modes — adaptive sampling (cost-efficient, preserves representative spans) and full-span retention (higher cost, recommended only if you need full-fidelity for compliance). The pricing table shows per-trace unit cost for both.
- Dashboard seats: we price 'editor seats' separately and provide an unlimited read-only viewer flag for SSO users under an account seat cap; alternatively you can use seatless metering billed by dashboard API calls.
- Discounts: standard 12-month commit starts at 15% off add-ons; above $100k ARR on add-ons we can move to 20% with a revenue-based SKU. Markus (cc) can confirm if there’s room for an extra concession.

Can you confirm the retention tier you prefer and whether you need full-span retention for compliance? When you confirm, I’ll have Markus draft a concrete quote and a simple 12-month SOW + implementation credits line.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart

- We’d like Extended for metrics (365 days) and Extended for traces (90 days) to start. We may expand to full-span retention for a subset of services (payment + auth) but would prefer adaptive sampling for the rest.
- Dashboard usage: ~12 editors, ~85 read-only team members. We prefer a seat-based model with an option to overflow to seatless metering for spikes.
- Procurement ask: can you provide pricing with a 12-month commit and also with a 24-month commit? Our finance team typically asks for both so they can see the TCO delta.

- 12-month commit (Extended profile): 20% discount on add-on list price (applies when add-on ARR >= $60k). Includes 1 month onboarding credits and 5 support hours.
- 24-month commit: 27% discount, 2 months onboarding credits, 10 support hours, and a one-time migration assistance credit.
- Full-span retention for scoped services billed at 3x adaptive-trace unit price; you can nominate up to 10 services for full-span in the SOW.
- Dashboard seats: $120/editor/month, read-only users are included under SSO with no additional seat charge up to 100 users; overflow seatless metering billed per 10k dashboard API calls.

We can include unused seat carry-forward as a 6-month rollover on annual plans (not available on monthly).
